title: implement SGD

atoms.evidence: self.params = list(params) — comment: 'turn params into a list (it might be a generator, so iterating over it empties it)'
self.b = [t.zeros_like(p) for p in self.params] — per-parameter momentum buffer allocation at init
for param in self.params: param.grad = None — explicit markdown discussion of why None vs zeros is the standard
g = theta.grad inside the step loop
theta -= self.lr * g  # inplace operation, to modify params — solution comment explicitly calls this out
b.copy_(self.mu * b + g)  # this does need to be inplace, since we're modifying the value in `self.b` — solution comment explicitly calls this out
@t.inference_mode() decorator on step; markdown notes 'we've added the torch.inference_mode decorator to the step method'
if self.lmda != 0: g = g + self.lmda * theta — fold lambda*theta into the gradient (L2-style); pseudocode line 'g_t <- g_t + lambda*theta_{t-1}'
b.copy_(self.mu * b + g); g = b — pseudocode line 'b_t <- mu*b_{t-1} + g_t'
if self.lmda != 0: ... and if self.mu != 0: ... — pseudocode 'if lambda != 0' / 'if mu != 0' both implemented as conditional shortcuts
